         1       Paterson.

         2                      SENATOR PATERSON:  Mr. President,

         3       last year this bill was debated by Senator

         4       Galiber.  As you know, Senator Galiber is ill

         5       and has not been with us for a couple of weeks,

         6       but he did ask me to get up and make a statement

         7       that would reflect his and many of our points of

         8       view on this particular bill.

         9                      We feel this bill is unnecessary

        10       because the federal program that allows for the

        11       state to receive funding because of the legisla

        12       tion can be received and is being received by 31

        13       states right now, and so, in other words, the

        14       Governor and the Legislature can opt out of this

        15       program simply by passing a resolution that

        16       would state that we are in disagreement with the

        17       federal legislation.

        18                      Moving to the substance of the

        19       actual legislation itself, we would just like to

        20       point out, as Senator Galiber informed me, that

        21       this legislation really is ancillary to the

        22       actual nature of the crime of possession or

        23       dealing of drugs.  In other words, the automo











                                                             
7058

         1       bile license and the actual crime are two

         2       separate things which is generally not

         3       considered in the purview of criminal justice

         4       law to be something that is consistent and goes

         5       on at other points.

         6                      If we want to punish someone for

         7       the crime of dealing drugs, which is as violent

         8       and vicious an act that probably exists in

         9       society today, then we need to punish the

        10       individual for that act.  The ancillary issues

        11       of the car and the driver's license might

        12       actually apply if the car was being used to

        13       assist the actual drug sale.  In these types of

        14       cases, it's just the proximity or the use of the

        15       car which we don't think is actually germane to

        16       the charge for which the defendant is arrested

        17       and eventually convicted.

        18                      And so, therefore, Senator

        19       Galiber recommends a no vote on this particular

        20       legislation.
